summary: Tested workspace_mode + dual_mode e2e (backend + web frontend). Backend endpoints (PUT /api/settings/workspace-mode, PUT /api/settings/dual-mode) persist correctly and /auth/me reflects the values for both serkan (is_owner=true) and mgr_test (is_owner=false, role=manager). Owner immunity is FULLY working: serkan in personal mode still sees Sidebar tab-team/tab-orphans and all team-only Settings tabs (users, errorradar, companies, licenses, visibility, announcements, roles, monitoring). Settings 'Mod' tab controls (workspace-dual-toggle, workspace-mode-personal, workspace-mode-team cards) all work and call the backend. The quick-mode-switch button in NEURAL LINK header appears when dual_mode=true, toggles the label KİŞİSEL⇄EKİP, and persists to backend. HOWEVER, a HIGH PRIORITY UI bug was found: the Sidebar's `tabOrder` state is only initialized on mount and never re-syncs when `teamFeaturesVisible` (canSeeTeam) flips at runtime. As a result, for non-owner managers (mgr_test) the quick-mode-switch does NOT dynamically show/hide the Ekibim + Yarım Kalan sidebar tabs — a page reload is required. This defeats the intended UX of the Çift Mod quick-switch. Backend tests: 3/3 pass. Frontend tests: 1/2 flows pass fully (serkan pass, mgr_test in-place switch fails; state-after-reload works).

ui_bugs.issue: Sidebar `tabOrder` state is derived once (useState initializer) from DEFAULT_ORDER which depends on `canSeeTeam`. There is NO useEffect syncing tabOrder when canSeeTeam/teamFeaturesVisible flips at runtime. Also SidebarTabBar renders `tabOrder.map(...)` without a `canSeeTab` filter. Result: (a) non-owner manager in personal mode who flips to team via quick-mode-switch does NOT get tab-team / tab-orphans until page reload; (b) reverse direction (team→personal via quick-switch) leaves the two tabs still visible until reload. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/Sidebar.jsx:114 (useState init), :101-113 (DEFAULT_ORDER), :747 (tabOrder passed to SidebarTabBar); /app/frontend/src/components/sidebar/SidebarTabBar.jsx:173 (renders tabOrder without canSeeTab filter).

action_items: Fix Sidebar.jsx to re-sync tabOrder when canSeeTeam/teamFeaturesVisible changes. Two options: (1) Add a useEffect that when canSeeTeam changes, injects/removes 'team' and 'orphans' entries from tabOrder (and persists) — preserving user's manual ordering. (2) Filter the rendered tab list through canSeeTab: change SidebarTabBar.jsx line 173 to `tabOrder.filter(canSeeTab).map(...)` AND ensure tabOrder is a superset that always includes team/orphans for manager+ (so hiding via canSeeTab handles the mode switch). Option (2) is smaller and safer. The same applies to activeFloatingKeys logic (already filters by canSeeTab at Sidebar.jsx:637 — good), just missing at the visible-tab-list level.
Consider also: when the active `tab` is 'team'/'orphans' and canSeeTab becomes false, Sidebar.jsx:96-99 falls back to 'history' — good, keep.
critical_code_review_comments: Sidebar.jsx: tabOrder is duplicated state (localStorage + useState) that isn't reactive to canSeeTeam. Consider deriving visible tabs directly from a computed value or forcing re-init on canSeeTeam change.
SidebarTabBar.jsx line 173 lacks the canSeeTab guard already applied elsewhere in Sidebar.jsx (line 637 for floating tabs, line 572 for tab activation). Guard is inconsistent.

rca of the issue: In Sidebar.jsx, DEFAULT_ORDER is IIFE-computed from `canSeeTeam` at render, but `tabOrder` is stored in useState and only reads the initializer once (or from localStorage). No effect resynchronizes tabOrder when canSeeTeam flips. SidebarTabBar.jsx renders `tabOrder.map(...)` directly (line 173) with no canSeeTab filter, so the render depends entirely on the stale tabOrder. Reproduction: (1) Login as mgr_test; (2) Set workspace_mode=personal, dual_mode=true, reload; (3) Click quick-mode-switch (personal→team); (4) Expect tab-team and tab-orphans to appear in sidebar — actually they don't. Reloading page reveals the tabs because DEFAULT_ORDER is recomputed with canSeeTeam=true. Mitigation: filter tabOrder by canSeeTab at render, and pre-seed tabOrder to always include team/orphans for isManagerOrAdmin users so filtering hides/shows dynamically.
